messages:
zoe: Heads up: my docs PR 472 looks green but local preview via docker-compose serves the site under /local/ which breaks absolute asset paths. Netlify preview is clean. Anyone seen this pattern?

patrick: which assets 404?

zoe: fonts and some permalinks. Local requests hit /local/_static/... 404, while Netlify serves /_static/... leading-slash in MkDocs is the culprit.

marie: our local compose mounts docs inside a subpath to avoid port collisions. We could either change mkdocs for local runs or make the compose proxy strip /local/. I'd prefer proxy change.

zoe: pushed a tiny nginx tweak to docker/nginx/local-proxy.conf: `location /local/ { proxy_pass http://docs:8000/; }`. Quick test shows assets load.

ci-bot: Vercel preview for PR-472: linkcheck step failed on trailing slash redirects (302 -> same-host). Netlify pass, local pass.

patrick: linkchecker is strict about redirects. We should add a rule to accept same-host 3xx responses rather than changing content. Can we follow up?

marie: agree. Let's merge the proxy fix now (local only) and open issue to relax linkcheck to avoid blocking unrelated PRs.

devex-bot: Merge window opens at 09:30 PST. Please ensure at least one non-author approval and passing CI.

patrick: reviewed and left a minor comment to document the proxy behavior in CONTRIBUTING.md.

zoe: added a short note and a quick local run snippet to CONTRIBUTING.md. CI green except Vercel linkcheck. I'm going to merge during the window and file issue #793 for linkcheck.

marie: cheers. After merge, can someone run the local smoke: `docker-compose -f docker/local.yml up --build` then curl `http://localhost:8000/local/_static/css/site.css` -> expect 200.

zoe: smoke passed and merged. Issue created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/793

patrick: nice, thanks for handling this quickly :thumbsup:
